newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 index drops 1.5 pts to 491.6 at fixing.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 index drops 1.5 pts to 491.6 at fixing.

text.p: Czech equities traded sideways in Friday's morning price fixing at the Prgaue Stock Exchange, leaving the main indices close to Thursday's closing levels.
The bourse's official PX50 index fell 1.5 points, or 0.30 percent, to 491.6 points, and the Reuters RPIX index dipped 1.8 points, or 0.18 percent, to 1,017.5.
Overall on the PX50, 21 issues rose, an equal number lost and eight remained unchanged.
Among the market heavyweights, telephone monopoly SPT Telecom gained one crown to 3,401.
